report_draft.technique: Standard CT diagnostic acquisition. Multi-planar volumetric reconstruction.

report_draft.findings:

OSSEOUS STRUCTURES: Acute cortical discontinuity noted in the right lateral ribs compatible with fracture.

1. STAT CRITICAL: PULMONARY EMBOLISM identified with high confidence (47%). Recommend immediate clinical correlation and STAT CT Angiography / Anticoagulation Review.
1. STAT CRITICAL: LARGE VESSEL OCCLUSION identified with high confidence (47%). Recommend immediate clinical correlation and STAT Endovascular Thrombectomy Protocol.
